name: Snow Falls on Enceladus
source:
You're flying by Saturn when your ship suddenly requires you to make an emergency landing. Crash landing on Enceladus, you meet a strange alien girl. 


[From [url=https://oyunorka.itch.io/snow-falls-on-enceladus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你飞越土星时，你的飞船突然要求你紧急着陆。迫降土卫二，你遇到了一个奇怪的外星女孩。


[来自[url=https://oyunorka.itch.io/snow-falls-on-enceladus]itch.io[/url]]
